02 / ASK, TEST, REPEAT

Research.

CURRENT / SEP 2026–PRESENT
Dana Carney Lab
UC Berkeley Haas School of Business · Undergraduate researcher
I develop Python and PyTorch pipelines to extract facial, vocal, and paralinguistic features from video and audio. The work supports research on political ideology, race, and socioeconomic status.
PREVIOUS / SUMMER 2023
Evaluating bias in LLM decisions
UC Berkeley AI Research · Student researcher
I built a 1,020-prompt benchmark to study bias in model decisions across healthcare, criminal justice, and business scenarios. I collected model choices and logits from FLAN, Vicuna, LLaMA, and LLaMA 2.
Read the resulting paper ↗
WHERE I WANT TO GO NEXT
AI safety, through evaluations.
I want to pursue research in AI safety, focusing on model evaluations and benchmarks. My earlier work on bias is a starting point for that direction.
